access.title: Admin panel access
access.lead: The restriction applies to the admin panel port only. The agent port is not affected, servers stay connected.
access.mode.label: Mode
access.mode.off.hint: The admin panel is open to everybody who reaches the port.
access.mode.white.hint: Whatever is not listed is refused. Good when you know where you sign in from.
access.mode.black.hint: Whatever is not listed is allowed. Closes only the addresses you know are unwanted.
access.host.badgeHint: A host name: the addresses come from DNS
access.host.stillDown: DNS does not answer: the last known address of {host} is kept
access.host.failing: DNS has not answered for {ago}, the last known address is in force
access.host.expired: DNS has not answered for {ago}, the address is too old and no longer in force
access.host.note: Names are read again once a minute. When the provider changes the address, the old one stays allowed until the DDNS record is updated. If the provider shares one address between many subscribers (CGNAT), a list by such an address protects little.
access.err.addr: Bad address or name. Example: 203.0.113.7, 203.0.113.0/24 or home.example.org.
access.err.dup: This address is already in the list.
access.err.dupHost: This name is already in the list.
access.err.unresolved: DNS does not know {host}. Check the DDNS record.
access.onlyProxy.hint: A direct connection to the admin panel port (a local network included) gets 403 even when its address is in the list.
access.test.title: Check an address
access.test.ignored: the X-Forwarded-For header was ignored, the proxy is not trusted
access.reason.only_proxy: direct connections are refused, only trusted proxies are allowed
access.reason.in_white: the address is in the white list
access.reason.not_in_white: the address is not in the white list
access.reason.in_black: the address is in the black list
access.reason.not_in_black: the address is not in the black list
access.problem.trust_all: Everybody is trusted (0.0.0.0/0): anyone can send X-Forwarded-For and forge the client address. Narrow the list to the address of your proxy.
access.problem.proxy_unlisted: Requests come from {ip} and carry X-Forwarded-For, but this address is not a trusted proxy. The server sees every visitor as {ip}: if that address gets into a list, the whole internet is let in.
access.problem.white_empty: The white list is empty: nobody can sign in after it is applied.
access.problem.lockout: This would lock you out: your address {ip} — {reason}.
access.problem.host_unresolved: DNS does not know {host}: it has no address. Check the DDNS record or remove the name from the list.
access.confirm.title: Apply the restriction?
access.confirm.you: You will get in as {ip}. If you still lose access, run linager access reset on the server.
access.confirm.audit: The action will be written to the audit log.
access.failed: Could not save the access settings.
access.proxy.title: Trusted proxies
access.proxy.trustAll: Default list: X-Forwarded-* headers are believed from any address, so the client address can be forged. Add the address of your proxy and remove 0.0.0.0/0.
access.proxy.seen: This request came from {peer} with X-Forwarded-For: {xff}. Is it your proxy?
access.proxy.direct: This request came directly from {peer}, without proxy headers. No proxy detected.
access.proxy.unlisted: Proxy {peer} was detected, but it is not in the list. Until it is trusted, the server sees every visitor as {peer}.
access.proxy.empty: The list is empty: X-Forwarded-* headers are ignored, the client address is the address of the connection.
access.proxy.err.all: Trusting every address is unsafe, enter the address of the proxy.
access.proxy.err.host: Only addresses are allowed here: a host name would open a way to forge X-Forwarded-For.
access.log.title: Access journal
access.log.untrustedHint: X-Forwarded-For is present, but the proxy is not trusted
access.log.exists: This address is already in the list
access.log.foot: The journal holds page opens, sign-ins (good and failed) and refused requests. Background requests of the interface are not written. Changes of the lists go to the audit log.
